geometry.on_chip_state: 896 decoded hidden values, one signed 96-bit accumulator, one held logit, and 10 winners; no full-logit vector

numeric_semantics.overflow: binary16 result saturates to signed max finite and sets saturation
numeric_semantics.nonfinite: NaN or infinity on hidden or weight input rejects the transaction and sets invalid_operand
numeric_semantics.zero: exact zero rounds to positive zero

protocol.reset: active-low asynchronous abort and state clear
protocol.clear: active-high synchronous abort and state clear
protocol.start: one accepted start opens exactly one hidden vector and one complete vocabulary traversal
protocol.hidden: indices 0 through 895 exactly once; hidden_last and hidden_end are asserted only on index 895
protocol.weights: token IDs 0 through 151935 and features 0 through 895 exactly once in order
protocol.weight_framing: weight_last_feature marks every feature 895; weight_last_token and weight_end mark only token 151935 feature 895
protocol.truncation: an early explicit hidden_end or weight_end is rejected; silence without an end marker has no timeout semantics
protocol.backpressure: logit and Top-K payloads remain stable while valid is asserted and ready is not exactly one
protocol.completion: Top-K ranks 0 through 9 are accepted before done is exposed
protocol.error_recovery: error is sticky and accepts no new transaction until clear or reset

top_k.materialization: insertion into 10 retained winners as each logit is accepted

error_codes.1: unknown accepted payload or framing bit
error_codes.4: last/end framing mismatch or explicit early truncation

claim_boundary.demonstrated_by_required_evidence: standalone final-RMSNorm FP16 hidden to authenticated tied lm_head and deterministic Top-K
